content: 1. A randomized clinical trial was conducted and published in the Journal of the American Academy of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry in 2000, volume 39, issue 11, pages 1347–1355. 2. Cohen JA and Mannarino AP investigated interventions for sexually abused children and reported their initial treatment outcome findings in the journal Child Maltreatment in 1998, volume 3, issue 1, pages 17–26. 3. Cohen JA and Mannarino AP identified predictors of treatment outcomes in sexually abused children, with their findings published in Child Abuse & Neglect in 2000, volume 24, issue 7, pages 983–994. 4. Cohen JA, Mannarino AP, and Knudsen K conducted a study on treating sexually abused children, presenting a one-year follow-up of a randomized controlled trial in Child Abuse & Neglect in 2005, volume 29, issue 2, pages 135–145. 5. Celano M, Hazzard A, Webb C, and McCall C evaluated the treatment of traumagenic beliefs among sexually abused girls and their mothers, with results published in the Journal of Abnormal Child Psychology in 1996, volume 24, issue 1, pages 1–17. 6. Cohen JA and Mannarino AP conducted a treatment outcome study for sexually abused preschool children, reporting their initial findings in the Journal of the American Academy of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry in 1996, volume 35, issue 1, pages 42–50. 7. Cohen JA and Mannarino AP explored factors mediating treatment outcomes for sexually abused preschool children, with their findings published in the Journal of the American Academy of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry in 1996, volume 35, issue 10, pages 1402–1410. 8. Cohen JA and Mannarino AP conducted a treatment study for sexually abused preschool children, reporting outcomes during a one-year follow-up in the Journal of the American Academy of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry in 1997, volume 36, issue 9, pages 1228–1235. 9. Cohen JA and Mannarino AP examined factors mediating treatment outcomes for sexually abused preschool children during sixand twelve-month follow-ups, with findings published in the Journal of the American Academy of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry in 1998, volume 37, issue 1, pages 44–51. 10. Deblinger E, Lippmann J, and Steer R studied sexually abused children suffering from post-traumatic stress symptoms, reporting initial treatment outcome findings in Child Maltreatment in 1996, volume 1, issue 4, pages 310–321. 11. Deblinger E, Steer RA, and Lippmann J conducted a two-year follow-up study of cognitive behavioral therapy for sexually abused children with post-traumatic stress symptoms, with results published in Child Abuse & Neglect in 1999, volume 23, issue 12, pages 1371–1378. 12. Hyde C, Bentovim A, and Monck E discussed clinical and methodological implications of a treatment outcome study for sexually abused children, with their findings published in Child Abuse & Neglect in 1995, volume 19, issue 11, pages 1387–1399.
